title: Sheba Microsystems founded (2015 per company release; 2016 per Ontario delegate page)
detail: Fabless Toronto MEMS company led by CEO Dr. Faez Ba-Tis and CTO Ridha Ben Mrad; founding year given as 2015 in its Jan-2024 release summary and 2016 on the Ontario CES-2026 delegate page.

title: Sheba launches MEMS AF actuator for 'active athermalization' in embedded vision cameras
detail: BusinessWire release: MEMS autofocus actuator for automotive, action, drone, machine vision, security and robotics cameras.

title: Sheba launches MEMS sensor-shift AF compact camera for AR/VR/XR headsets (<10 mW, <5 ms)
detail: 'Sheba MEMS Autofocus Compact Camera for AR/VR/XR Headsets': electrostatic µPistons move the image sensor; <10 mW, <5 ms response, <0.5 µm precision, supports large-aperture optics, no EMI; targets 'consumer and enterprise AR/VR/XR'. No customers named.

title: Sheba Sharp-7 'world's first autofocus automotive camera' (8 MP, -40 to 150 °C)
detail: Sharp-7 with integrated MEMS driver; demo at AutoSens Detroit 2024-05-21/23; evaluation kits 'exclusively available for OEMs and Tier 1 customers'.

title: Sheba appoints Matt Crowley (ex-Sand 9, Vesper, Qualcomm) Senior Strategic Advisor
detail: BusinessWire listing of the advisor appointment.

title: DXOMARK test report on Sheba Sharp-7 across automotive temperature range
detail: BusinessWire listing: DXOMARK validation of the Sharp-7 autofocus automotive camera.

title: CES 2026 Ontario delegation lists Sheba: 17 staff, USD 400K annual sales
detail: Ontario delegate page for CES 2026 (2026-01-06 to 01-09): 'Founded: 2016; Staff: 17; Annual sales: USD 400K'; targets include 'AR/VR camera systems'. Indicates sub-consumer-ramp scale.

title: Sheba appoints Vincent Cruvellier COO, 'Enters New Acceleration Phase'
detail: COO brings 'industrialization, supply chain, manufacturing readiness' experience; no customer or volume target published.

title: Sheba names Teledyne MEMS production partner for ADAS camera actuators (not Meta)
detail: Press release concerns temperature-compensated actuators for driver-assistance cameras, not consumer glasses.
